_comment: The two images in the tester-invitation email.
`crop` is the fraction cut from the top of the capture. The captures are 1440x3120 and their
top third is chat history; what carries the argument is the dictated paragraph and the keyboard
below it. Cutting there is what lets the type inside the phone stay readable at email size.
The captions are not the store captions. The store speaks to strangers and has to explain that
punctuation is automatic. These readers already dictate with VibeVoice every day -- to them that
is a premise, not news. So the cards name the thing they have actually been putting up with.
